title: Default Model Configuration
subtitle: These defaults apply when a task does not specify a model

primary.label: Primary Model
primary.description: Used when no model is specified, for everyday conversations and complex tasks

fast.label: Fast Model
fast.description: Used for lightweight tasks; falls back to the primary model when unset
fast.hint: When not configured, all tasks use the primary model

image_understanding.label: Image Understanding
image_understanding.description: Analyze images and screenshots, support mixed image-text conversations

speech_recognition.label: Speech Recognition
speech_recognition.description: Convert speech to text, support voice input

selection.notConfigured: Not configured, will use primary model

empty.noModels: No models available. Add API models or import a subscription first.

messages.fastModelCleared: Fast model cleared; the primary model will be used
